reviews.t: The best gel base and topcoat set I’ve used!!
reviews.x: This is the best gel base and topcoat set I’ve found so far! The gel basecoat prevents any products I use from staining my nails, and it protects my nails from anything I put on them! The topcoat cures quickly and protects my polish and nail art under a thick, glossy layer of gel, which has a beautiful hard shiny finish. I also like that these are no wipe, which makes them easier to use since there is no sticky layer after curing!

The top coat is awful. It gets cloudy the second you touch it after curing. Waste of money and can’t return it since I already used it. The base is also extremely runny.  I’ve been doing gel nails for years and have never used a product that was so bad.

reviews.t: No Wipe Top Coat! REALLY WORKS!
reviews.x: This nail polish was awesome to use, I cured it for 90 seconds each time with a LED light.  The base coat wasn't gloopy or gross, it applied easily. The smell wasn't overpowering either. The top coat on the other hand was a bit thinner, and it smelled. It wasn't too bad but it was very weird for a nail polish lol. I loved that it's a "No Wipe" Top Coat. I feel like having alcohol is just too much stuff when I do my nails. My polish wasn't sticky or tacky when I finished. I haven't had the polish

Very disappointed in this item.  Everything seemed OK until I put the top coat on.  No matter what I did, it seemed too thick and never cured all of the way.  For at least two days it felt tacky and smelt and tasted like I had rubber cement on my fingers. It also lost its shine in less than a day. Waste of money.  Ended up ordering another brand that works much better.

Don't buy, do not buy this product. It's a waste of money. I was excited for this product and the packaging is pretty. However thanks a lot to the product I lost money with my client. The top coat base is so thick and it's cloudy almost white hue to it. Takes forever to somewhat harden. It's no good straight trash. Don't buy,, don't buy,  don't buy, don't.

I used this system with one of their glittery gel polishes at I was super impressed.  It lasted a long time, no discoloration, just perfect.  For this price it's really a good deal!  Also!!! because it's a nowipe top coat that means I an use it for my chrome/holo powders too! YAY!

reviews.t: Soak off makes it susceptible to lifting and chipping
reviews.x: I wanted to love this product but it just doesn't hold. It lifted the day of application. I even tried painting it again but the next day it lifted.

reviews.t: I can see my reflection from the top coats glossiness!
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:7e314eb68d3d14994f418f96e03962ca]] Okay so besides 1 gel top coat I've bought ages ago and used before I've never played with gels all that much because they've seem complicated and messy and I was more accustomed to normal nail polish. However! These are phenomenal, they are rubbery enough that they don't glide all over and over fill my cuticles. The base coat does a great job at adhering to the gel polishes I used (also from LagunaMoon) and the top coat is so unbelievably glossy I co

When I opened the bottle, there was dried pieces of polish around the edges (maybe it had opened a little?). I thought the polish itself was going to be okay but when I used the top coat it had little clumps/crystals in it and was hard to put the top coat on smoothly. Besides that issue, I like this brand a lot more than the last one I tried because it doesn't shrink away from the edges at all as it cures.

Honestly the WORST top coat I’ve used. After application it looked nice, nothing too impressive though. However, It doesn’t not last!!!! After one day it seems the ENTIRE top coat was removed and my gel polish was left looking extremely dull. Such a disappointment, returning.

The bottom coat and top coat both went on smoothly. Not lumpy, not too thick. Very easy to use. Exactly what I was looking for. Any imperfections were my fault because I was a little lazy taking off the previous polish and with the application.

I had to return them. The top gel smells ok but the base gel smell like plastic on fire. I have been using gel nail for 5 years so far and tried different brands. It is my first time to smell something like that.
The base coat doesn't apply evenly. The top coat is really thick and not easy to apply. Also, the top coat loses its shine in less than a day. I would not purchase this product again.
Did not like this product at all....the top coat doesnt even stay for a couple hours....its good packaging but thats about it....i do not recommend this product 7
i didnt like it at all, i couldnt make it work

This has only been the second gel base and top coat that I've used. I'm not super familiar with them, but the lagunamoon is incredible in comparison to the other brand that I used from Sally beauty. It's quite thick and has a strange odor, but the finished product is excellent. The nails are smooth and level when cured. I have had to apply two base coats each use though. The base coat is sticky and about half of the coat comes if when you wipe off the sticky layer. A second coat of base covers e

I used the base and top coat along with LagunaMoon gel polishes and they work pretty well. I only applied the base to my thumb because I like to change colors often, so I wore a peel off base on the rest of the nails. But, in order to try the longevity, I applied "as normal" to my thumb. I've only had the polish on for one week; it was my first time using gels, so I am not an expert on application, and the thumb still looks great! The only thing I didn't like was that the top coat was a bit too

reviews.t: Some are good, some aren't so much
reviews.x: Review for top and base coat: (Disclaimer: This product was sent to me) This product works really well! The topcoat helps to smooth out imperfections very easily. The base coat seems to perform as well as any other base coat does.  Review for Colors of 2019 set: So I was very excited when I received this set because the colors are so beautiful. But, the two shiny polishes were a bit goopy and when I was curing them, I was getting major heat spikes. I tried the set again to see what would happen,

The polish itself stinks pretty bad even after curing under the UV. The Base coat never completely cures. I did a thin layer and sat under the UV longer and longer even with multiple sessions to see if it got better....and it still remains gummy and sticky to the touch. Adding gel polish is a waste as it never sets up correctly and the manicure falls apart after just a day or so. Very disappointed considering the reviews. I find this cheap and worse on the nails as peeling screws up the nail. A

reviews.t: PERFECT GLOSSY GEL TOP COAT AND BASE COAT!
reviews.x: I found this product to be a very pleasant surprise! This base coat and top coat are easy to use and are beyond salon quality. The drying time was very short, it only took me 30 seconds to be completely dry. And the finish of the top coat was thick and shiny, exactly what I want in a gel top coat. I also noticed they had very nice brushes that made application easy. I run a nail page on Instagram, so have high quality products is absolutely necessary. This top coat and base coat definitely go ab

The base coat seems to work well. It is slightly tacky after curing which helps the polish adhere better. The curing time was about 2 minutes. The top coat was incredibly thick. After 2 mins of curing it is still tacky and quite soft. I have cured it out to 4 mins with little change. It does still have to be wiped with alcohol. Overall these work well enough for the price. They would make a good inexpensive starter for someone wanting to try gel base and top coats before spending a ton of money.

When I bought the base and topcoat polishes, I didn't realize that a UV lamp was required. So make sure to read the descriptions before you buy them. However, the customer service team was very kind and replied very quickly. When I applied the base coat, it made my nails look very shiny and glassy. It didn't have a strong nail polish scent either which is a HUGE plus for me since I am prone to getting headaches from scents. Also, the two polish bottles look so cute on my vanity.

🛑POST DISCLAIMER🛑 . First of all, despite my obvious #Asian descent, I’m a TERRIBLE #nailpolisher 💅🏽 . BUT! ☝🏽 Despite all that, I love this #gelpolish by @lagunamoonbeauty 💖 . It’s definitely really great #quality #nailpolish and I’m very grateful that they chose me to #gift me some of their products! . The #basecoat and #topcoat duo is great and this blue and yellow are quite lovely 😊 . I’m confident that if I were better at doing #nails, they would be even better 🤣

I used these products with one of their polishes. The finished nails look nice. I have no clue how long you are supposed to cure base or top coat. I couldn't find any information on it even looking on Laquna Moon site. I have a LED 24watt nail lamp. I cured base 30 seconds and top coat 60 seconds which is same cure time as their polish. I just did nails so I'll update later on what kind of wear I get. My work can be hard on my nails so keep your fingers crossed.

This set is a good value. I would definitely get this for starting out with gel. I did notice the top coat has an almost rubber feel. I’ve had this happen with other no-wipe top coats so I don’t think it’s a flaw, just something I don’t prefer. The base did its job creating an even sticky base for the polish to adhere to. I would order as a gift for someone wanting to start out.

claims.text: Many reviewers report the top coat is thick, clumpy, or hard to apply smoothly.
Several reviewers say the top coat loses its shine or fails to last, sometimes within a day or hours.
Some reviewers praise the set for applying smoothly and providing a glossy, protective finish.
A few reviewers complain about unpleasant or strong smells from the base or top coat.
Some reviewers report durability issues such as lifting and chipping.
